This project keeps an in-repo research artifact
(`.omo/research/harness-research.md`) as the shared vocabulary for design
decisions. External study input keeps flowing on purpose — this template
is how it enters.

**The subject**

The harness, incident, vendor post-mortem, paper, or measured comparison
you are contributing knowledge about.

**The source**

Pinned references wherever possible: repository + commit SHA, issue or
CVE numbers, dated posts, changelog entries. Unarchivable claims ("a
blog said") are weaker receipts and will be marked as such.

**What it proves or disproves**

The capability, failure mode, or performance claim — and which existing
research-file section (if any) it corrects or extends.

**Suggested disposition**

ADOPT / AVOID / WATCH, with your reasoning. The maintainers will weigh it
against the decisions ledger (research §3) and reply with the verdict.
